name: Camouflage
body:
School transmutation; Level ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (internal organs of a chameleon)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

By changing the subject’s coloration to blend with that of its surroundings, the subject gets a +10 enhancement bonus on Stealth checks. The enhancement bonus increases to +20 at caster level 5th, and to +30 (the maximum) at caster level 9th.
